sentences.en: Dr. Hellebrandt is an associate professor in that excellent university.
sentences.zh: 赫勒布兰特博士是那所优秀大学的一名副教授。

sentences.en: You should associate with people who you believe are trustworthy.
sentences.zh: 你应该和你认为可靠的人交往。

sentences.en: The chairperson has been associated with the organization for ten years.
sentences.zh: 主席已经与该组织有十年的合作关系了。
